caption: The video captures an aerial view of a steep alpine ridge, where dark green grassy slopes carry scattered snow patches along the upper ridgelines and a deep saddle cuts diagonally through the center. A thick bank of white fog fills the right side of the frame, while within the central gully a bright plume of cloud continuously morphs and drifts. Its dense tongue shifts shape at the saddle mouth throughout the clip. The fog wrapping the rounded foreground shoulder slowly redistributes, gradually exposing a small patch of vegetation on its right slope. The camera drifts gently, nudging the scene downward so that an isolated snow fleck near the bottom edge slides partly out of view. The terrain itself appears unchanged while the cloud and viewpoint keep moving, the ridge remaining partly veiled by the drifting vapor.
